description: The whole reference profile's drawn parts: the Chats section (New chat, Pinned, chats by project or in one list, a sort, archive from a row), the thread hover card, quiet one-line row decorations, and the builder New Tab page.

scopes.chat:read: List your chats: to hide archived ones, for the project picker, and the ones waiting on you.
scopes.workspace:read: Know which workspace is open, to mark its chat.
scopes.workspace:write: Show a chat's workspace when you click it.
scopes.chat:write: Pin and archive the chats you choose.
scopes.actions:run: Start a chat, start one in the project you pick, or open one in a tab.
scopes.storage:local: Remember the sort, grouping and which lists are open.
